reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to show per-conversation LLM billing information directly in the DSH web composer by pulling gateway pricing from a configured endpoint and converting model token usage into visible cost summaries.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web Composer 中展示逐对话计费信息，基于配置的网关价格接口获取定价并按模型调用与 input/output/cache token 实时计算费用。
summaries.en: This plugin displays per-conversation billing information in DSH Web's composer, fetching pricing from a configured gateway endpoint and calculating model usage costs from input/output/cache tokens in real time.

capabilities: Fetches pricing data from a user-configured gateway endpoint
Calculates per-conversation costs from model usage and pricing rules
Displays billing and token summaries in the DSH web composer UI

reasons.code: README documents a configurable `pricingUrl` for New API/One API pricing table retrieval and periodic refresh, requiring external service access configured by the user.
README states it iterates conversation model call nodes and converts input/output/cache token usage with pricing fields into per-conversation billing totals.
package.json indicates a web client plugin with injected DSH client modules, confirming UI/in-conversation integration via the composer interface.

capabilities: Fetches pricing data from a user-configured gateway endpoint
